packet.title: Task-Orchestrator Container Runtime and Project Workflow Router Parity Fix
packet.container_parity_status: Passed for startup, /health, /info, /api/projects/1/workflow/state, and MCP stdio; blocked for live workflow-ideas empty-state by downstream bridge drift

planned_slices.name: Slice 2
planned_slices.objective: Mount the project workflow router in the active runtime

completed_slices.name: Slice 1
completed_slices.summary: Dockerfile now starts `uvicorn app.main:app` instead of the legacy hard-fail module.

completed_slices.name: Slice 2
completed_slices.summary: The canonical FastAPI runtime mounts the project workflow router and no longer imports unrelated routers at package import time.

completed_slices.name: Slice 3
completed_slices.summary: Dedicated-worktree container builds and serves `/health`, `/info`, and `/api/projects/1/workflow/state`; in-image `mcp_stdio` resolves `app.main`.

replan_events.reason: Fresh container rebuild exposed import-time package side effects beyond the initial Dockerfile/router seams.
replan_events.action: Added minimal adjacent bootstrap fixes in `app/api/__init__.py` and `src/dopemux/pm/__init__.py` to remove unrelated startup dependencies from this runtime path.

skipped_abandoned_merged.name: Live workflow-ideas empty-state closure
skipped_abandoned_merged.rationale: Current `dopecon-bridge` runtime returns `404` on `/kg/custom_data` reads; bridge authority changes are out of scope for this packet.

verification: Docker inspect for the rebuilt container shows command `["uvicorn","app.main:app","--host","0.0.0.0","--port","8000"]`.
Container startup logs show `app.main` lifespan initialization and `Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:8000`.
`pytest services/task-orchestrator/tests/test_health_route.py` passed with the new project workflow route test.
Inside the image, `python -c 'from app.main import mcp as app_mcp; import mcp_stdio; ...'` prints `True` and `Task-Orchestrator`.
Forced downstream failure variant returns `503` for `GET /api/workflow/ideas`.

evidence_ledger.router_mount_status_before: Project workflow router defined in `app/api/project_workflow.py` but not mounted in `app.main`; `/api/projects/1/workflow/state` returned 404 from the worktree runtime.
evidence_ledger.router_mount_status_after: Project workflow router imported and mounted in `app.main`; `/api/projects/1/workflow/state` returns 200 from the rebuilt container.

body.detail: Failed to fetch custom_data workflow_ideas: All connection attempts failed

container_logs_summary: Rebuilt live container logs show canonical `app.main` startup and successful lifespan initialization.
Live container logs show `/api/projects/1/workflow/state` served with 200 after a downstream bridge 404 was converted into the route's empty workflow-state fallback.
Live container logs show `/api/workflow/ideas` still fails because `dopecon-bridge` returns 404 on `/kg/custom_data` reads.
Forced-failure container starts successfully; downstream connection failure still produces 503 for `/api/workflow/ideas`.
